description: This file defines the 'Country' entity class within the OrangeHRM project using Doctrine ORM annotations. It specifies properties such as countryCode, name, countryName, iso3, and numCode, along with their getter and setter methods, and maps the class to the 'hs_hr_country' database table.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Entity class representing a country with properties mapped to the 'hs_hr_country' database table, including country code, name, ISO3 code, and numeric code.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country.

methods.name: getIso3
methods.description: Returns the ISO3 code of the country, if available.

methods.name: setIso3
methods.description: Sets the ISO3 code of the country.

methods.name: getNumCode
methods.description: Returns the numeric code of the country, if available.

methods.name: setNumCode
methods.description: Sets the numeric code of the country.
